'''Jofotek-Bromnya''' is a [[Papuan language]] of [[Sarmi Regency]], Papua, [[Indonesia]].

There are two dialects:<ref name="Ethnologue22-ID">{{cite web |url=https://www.ethnologue.com/country/ID/languages |title=Indonesia languages |work=[[Ethnologue]]: Languages of the World |edition=22nd |editor1-last=Eberhard |editor1-first=David M. |editor2-last=Simons |editor2-first=Gary F. |editor3-last=Fennig |editor3-first=Charles D. |date=2019 |location=Dallas |publisher=[[SIL International]]}}</ref>

*'''Bromnya''' dialect, spoken in Srum village, Bonggo subdistrict
*'''Jofotek''' dialect, spoken in Biridua village, Pantai Timur subdistrict

Colonial records of '''Mander''' show it to be the same language.
